Book Openscapes Intro Calls (aka 1:1's )

Described in Approach Guide - [Pre-cohort engagement](https://openscapes.github.io/approach-guide/champions/pre-cohort-engage.html#intro-calls).

- [ ] create Google Calendar events in OpenscapesEvents calendar with 30-min meeting segments. The calendar you share from must be a public calendar. "Publish" the event (the 3 dots), copy the link and share that in welcome email
- [ ] in Welcome email, invite folks to book an intro call that should include their team, if they are participating with one
- [ ] day before intro calls, create one doc per meeting from template. Recently we have used one doc that is viewable but not editable outside our team.
- [ ] conduct intro calls
